answer: Each identity files one census return stamped in saffron each epoch, backed by a ferrous bond of 60 credits. Auditors sample 5% of returns and recheck the claimed work against the oasis ledger; a forged return burns the bond. First filing costs 35 credits, the kth 35+6(k-1): 1,000 fake identities pay 3,032,000 + 60,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented returns fail: they cannot match the filer's work history. An honest filer pays 35 once.
